repos.label: sg-kit
repos.desc: 场景图构建与增量更新的工具包

docs.README.md: sg-kit builds 3D scene graphs from RGB-D streams and keeps them up to date incrementally. Nodes are objects and places, edges are spatial relations (on, inside, next-to). Use SceneGraph.update(frame) to merge a new observation; the graph exposes query(relation, subject) for planners. Includes a baseline LLM planner that serialises the scene graph into the prompt for task planning.
docs.docs/incremental_update.md: Incremental update: each frame is segmented, objects are matched to existing nodes by embedding and position, stale nodes are pruned after N missed observations. This keeps long-horizon tasks consistent when objects move, which a one-shot scene graph cannot do.
docs.sgkit/planner.py: class SceneGraphPlanner: baseline that prompts an LLM with the serialised scene graph and the instruction, returns a list of skills (pick, place, open). Used as the scene-graph + LLM planning baseline in benchmarks.

repos.label: vla-bench
repos.desc: 长程操作任务的评测脚本和 baseline

docs.README.md: vla-bench evaluates vision-language-action policies on long-horizon manipulation suites. Metrics: task success rate, average completed subtasks, and error recovery rate after perturbations. Ships baselines: a flat VLA policy, a hierarchical VLA with action chunking, and a scene-graph-conditioned planner.
docs.docs/metrics.md: Success rate counts episodes where all subtasks finish. Subtask progress averages the fraction of subtasks completed. Recovery rate measures success after an object is moved mid-episode, the setting where error accumulation shows.
docs.baselines/hierarchical_vla.py: Hierarchical VLA baseline: a high-level policy chooses subgoals, a low-level VLA executes action chunks. Strong on short tasks, degrades on long-horizon tasks because subgoal errors compound.

repos.label: paper-tpl
repos.desc: 会议投稿用的 LaTeX 模板和画图脚本

docs.README.md: paper-tpl is an anonymous-submission LaTeX skeleton: main.tex with sections, refs.bib, a results table macro and plotting scripts. Compile with latexmk -pdf. Keep \author anonymous and avoid links to your own repositories during review.
docs.figures/plot_results.py: Plotting helper: reads a results CSV and draws grouped bar charts per metric for the paper.
